record_scope: new_trials_from_policy_adoption_only; not a complete reconstruction of all prior model trials

trials.reason: Pass a completed shadow ledger close to the existing currentAccount interface; prevent resetting a cash-only model account at later monthly cuts. No historical return or validation score selected the rule.

Model existing dividend entitlements as non-investable claims at an account cut; compute research allocations from settled cash plus priced positions and reserve claims until documented settlement. The change follows accounting identity, not fitted returns.

Separate a simulated ETF fund from the reference proposal: decisions start from the fund's own holdings, only US-listed ETFs are bought, combined equity is kept within 60-90%, the zero-premium low-conviction model constrains risk without ranking trades, and returning to a recently abandoned portfolio needs twice the confirmed gain. The 35% sector cap made every 60% equity portfolio infeasible under its conservative bound for unclassified holdings, so the fund uses 50%; no realized return or score informed either value.
